name: Moonmoth Drift
introDiscord:
Thousands of pale Moonmoth Nudibranchs drift through the kelp like
underwater moths. Their glowing backs follow reflected starlight through
paths hidden beneath the canopy.
introTwitch:
Thousands of pale Moonmoth Nudibranchs drift through the kelp like
underwater moths. Their glowing backs follow reflected starlight through
paths hidden beneath the canopy.

moonmoth-drift-approach.prompt: Three routes shimmer beneath clouds of drifting Moonmoths.

left.message:
One Moonmoth settles peacefully on a leaf.

Another joins it.

Then a much larger Nudibranch drops directly into your route and proves
that 'peaceful' was a premature classification.

right.message:
One Berry rests inside Shizuki's folded hood.

Her note reads:

'Moonmoths slept in hood.

Could not wear hood.

Was cold.

Still worth it.'

forward.message:
An offering basket glows beneath dozens of tiny Moonmoths. The Star
Candies inside reflect enough light to briefly attract even more.

moonmoth-drift-depths.prompt:
Living rootways curve beneath a migration cloud so thick the forest
looks full of silver snow.

left.message:
A moonblossom pool rests under a quiet branch.

Shizuki wrote:

'Rest spot.

Do not shake branch.

Trust me.'
left.fullHpMessage:
You leave the pool untouched and, more importantly, do not shake the
branch.

right.message:
A Moonmoth Nudibranch detaches from the migration cloud and glides
toward you with surprising speed.

forward.message:
Broad silver kelp wraps a Star Candy cache beneath several sleeping
Moonmoths.

You perform the quietest treasure opening of your career.

moonmoth-drift-threshold.prompt:
Moonlit fronds surround Dustlight Bower as three routes vanish beneath
pale drifting wings.

left.message:
A shrine coffer rests beneath a natural arch. Star Candies inside
scatter tiny points of reflected light across the entire Bower.

right.message:
Restorative sap sits beside Shizuki's handwritten review:

'Moonmoth pillow:
soft.
glowy.
moves away while sleeping.
Three stars.'
right.fullHpMessage: You leave the restorative sap and the migrating pillow review behind.

forward.message:
A cluster of Moonmoths suddenly parts around one much larger
Nudibranch.

It lands directly in the route.

Migration checkpoint.

boss-antechamber.name: Dustlight Bower
boss-antechamber.prompt:
The entire migration cloud circles the Bower instead of continuing
through it.

bossPromptDiscord:
Moonmoths fill Dustlight Bower from root to canopy.

Then every tiny creature turns toward the same pale silhouette overhead.

Two enormous glowing wings unfold among the drifting lights.

Use /yes to enter the Bower or /no to let the migration continue without
another disturbance.
bossPromptTwitch:
Moonmoths fill Dustlight Bower from root to canopy.

Then every tiny creature turns toward the same pale silhouette overhead.

Two enormous glowing wings unfold among the drifting lights.

Use !yes to enter the Bower or !no to let the migration continue without
another disturbance.
bossRetreatText:
You step away from Dustlight Bower. The migration continues circling
the hidden guardian.

boss.revealText:
The cloud parts as an enormous luminous Nudibranch descends like a pale
moth.

Pale-Wing Moonmoth reveals itself!

completionText:
"The Pale-Wing Moonmoth rejoins the drifting migration.

Thousands of tiny lights resume their journey through the forest.

One briefly lands on your shoulder before moving on."
